Title: MemorySmith.Agent — CI Baseline Status & Coverage Gap
Content:
## CI Workflow

GitHub Actions with a single build-and-test job on ubuntu-latest. Triggered on push/PR to main/master/feature/**.

**Full CI Step List:**
1. actions/checkout@v4
2. Setup .NET 10.0.x (actions/setup-dotnet@v4)
3. dotnet restore MemorySmith.Agent.slnx
4. dotnet build MemorySmith.Agent.slnx --no-restore --configuration Release -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true
5. dotnet test MemorySmith.Agent.slnx --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory artifacts/TestResults -- DataCollectionRunSettings.DataCollectors.DataCollector.Configuration.Format=cobertura
6. Validate task records: pwsh ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1

**Important:** Unlike the MemorySmith main repo, the Agent repo CI does NOT run Test-MemoryRecords.ps1, Test-PageLinks.ps1, or Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1 — these validation scripts exist only in the MemorySmith repo under Scripts/.

**Package versions (from MemorySmith.Agent.Tests.csproj):**
- NUnit 4.6.1, NUnit3TestAdapter 6.2.0, NUnit.Analyzers 4.14.0
- Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.7.0
- coverlet.collector 10.0.1
- GitHubActionsTestLogger 3.0.4
- Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing 10.0.9
- ci.runsettings activates GitHubActionsTestLogger

## Baseline (Sprint 59)

- **746+ tests passing**, 0 failures (per architecture.md)
- ~68 NUnit test files organized by sprint and feature
- Sprint-numbered test files: Sprint19Tests through Sprint57ExecutionContextTests (~24 sprint files)
- Core test files: ActionPlanTests, AgentBackgroundServiceTests, BlueprintParserTests, BuildGoalTests, ChatInterpreterTests, CoreModelsTests, CraftItemGoalTests, GatherWoodGoalTests, GenericGatherGoalTests, GoalFactoryTests, HtnPlannerTests, HtnTaskLibrary*Tests, ItemRegistryTests, ItemSpecParserTests, KnowledgeResolverTests, LlmChatInterpreterTests, LlmEvaluatorImplTests, ReplanGovernorTests, SimpleGoalTests, SurviveNightGoalTests, TaskSequenceGoalTests, ToolDispatcherTests, ToolEngineTests, WorldStateBuilderTests

## Coverage Gap

The Agent repo collects XPlat Code Coverage (cobertura format) in CI but:
- **No coverage report generation**: Unlike the MemorySmith main repo, which uses reportgenerator + actions/upload-artifact, the Agent repo does NOT generate HTML reports or publish coverage artifacts
- **No coverage thresholds**: No minimum coverage percentage is enforced
- **No coverage trend tracking**: No historical comparison between runs
- **No validation scripts coverage**: The Test-TaskRecords.ps1 validation step runs separately and is not included in coverage collection

This means coverage data is collected but never reviewed or actioned. Consider adding:
1. reportgenerator dotnet tool for HTML report generation
2. actions/upload-artifact to publish reports
3. A coverage badge or comment on PRs
4. Threshold enforcement (e.g., <threshold> block in .runsettings)
